title: Stronger Than Any Storm: Southern Leyte Mudslide
description: In 2006, U.S. and Philippine Forces conducted disaster relief operations in the Philippines after a massive rock slide-debris avalanche destroyed a mountain village in Southern Leyte. Capabilities practiced during annual exercises such as PHIBLEX better prepare the nations for real life operations. (U.S. Marine Corps Motion Imagery by Lance Cpl. Garett Burns/Relesed)
